title: Prints Near Frostmere
summary: Hanne Carver says something is out at the edge of Frostmere: tracks too big for a dog and fences torn outward. Learn what it is, then put it down.
offer_text: "There is sign at the tree line: tracks too big for a dog and fences torn outward. I cannot tell how many, or how bold. Read it for me, and then put them down."
turn_in_text: "Now we know what we are dealing with, and it is dealt with."

objectives.text: Find two signs of the wolves around the edge of Frostmere
Tell Hanne Carver what you found

relationship.label: Read the sign and acted on it
